resolved_findings.finding: Before numeric GT access, the script verifies source/capture complete flags, row lengths and frame/prediction hashes, then marks an enumeration of currently existing files as whole_run_complete. It does not first require the promised physics/requests/contacts/native IMU/policy/trajectory inputs, four nonempty videos, every action map/plan or terminal/capture/action count consistency. Missing artifacts could be omitted from this manifest while it still claims a complete whole run.
resolved_findings.required_resolution: Before creating the whole-run manifest or importing/running GT evaluator, fail closed on a declared required-file set and terminal/capture/source/action consistency, including four video and per-action map/plan coverage. Record exact scope: static metadata/file completeness, not verified numerical performance or video contents.

resolved_findings.resolution: score_C.py now requires nonempty mandatory source/physics/requests/contacts/IMU/policy/episode/stage/execution/gauge/primitives/loaded identity files; terminal actions1..900 and matching frame counts; policy/request action counts; physics NPZ field names without numeric reads; >=5 qualified native packets per action; exact per-action map/plan filenames and counts; frame/prediction file counts; four camera names and four nonempty video headers with capture frame counts.
